description: React-like component using Qwik framework for a notes management page, including fetching, displaying, editing, creating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: load$
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes based on URL query parameters, updates state, manages loading/error states.

methods.name: selectNote$
methods.description: Selects a note by ID and updates corresponding state.

methods.name: onChangeTitle$
methods.description: Updates the title of the currently selected note.

methods.name: onChangeContent$
methods.description: Updates the content of the currently selected note.

methods.name: onChangeTags$
methods.description: Updates the tags of the currently selected note.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Saves the current note, either updating or creating a new one, then reloads the notes list.

methods.name: onDelete$
methods.description: Deletes the selected note and updates the local notes list and selection.
